title: Stable Diffusion Mac
description: If you've got an Apple Silicon Mac and you want to generate AI images without paying for cloud services, this is the exact setup I use on my 64GB Mac Studio. I'll show you how to run Stable Diffusion locally, completely free, and the tool I recommend makes it dead simple. Disclosure: this video contains affiliate links. If you buy through them I may earn a commission at no extra cost to you. I only recommend tools I have actually used. As an affiliate I earn from qualifying purchases.
